According to the prosecution, the Applicants were found to be selling ' fruit beer' at about 16.00 hrs on 21.11.2021 in a public place. texts.arguments: 3. I have heard the learned counsel for the Applicants and the learned APP. 4. The learned APP has produced the report of the Food Analyst dated 10.12.2021, in which the analyst has found that the sample of the 'fruit beer' does not confirm to the standard of beer as per the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and the Food Safety and Standards (Alcoholic Beverages) Regulations, 2018 and were unsafe for human consumption.
